_about.description: eBag products linked to generic ingredients (ingredients.json). Rebuilt daily by scripts/sync_ebag.mjs. Entries with link "manual" are hand-curated: only price/stock/availability are refreshed. To fix a wrong auto link, add the product to data/ebag_overrides.json.

fields.sold_by: 'piece' = you buy whole packs; 'kg' = sold by weight in 1 kg steps
fields.pack.grams: net weight of one selling unit, in grams (for oil: ml x density)
fields.pack.count: number of items in the pack (eggs)
fields.pack.variable_weight: true = weight is an estimate; eBag bills the actual weight
fields.price.promo: promo price per selling unit, null if none
fields.price.bundle_note: eBag multi-pack discount is already included in price.regular
fields.label: eBag nutrition per 100 g (per 100 ml for oil), null if eBag has none
fields.label.source: 'energy_values' = structured field; 'description_text' = parsed from the description
fields.label.valid: false if kcal does not match the macros (4/4/9 kcal per g, + 2 per g fiber) within ~15%
fields.macro_rule: Use label when present and valid; otherwise use the ingredient's USDA macros.
fields.needs_review: a human should check this product
